title: Faculty Info Adjunct Lecturer on Education
bio: Home Faculty Directory Susan Johnson McCabe is an adjunct lecturer in education at HGSE, a proven leader of digital transformations, and a passionate advocate for education innovation. She’s held senior management positions in a global edtech startup serving universities in Asia, North/South America, and Europe, then at a top 5 global IT/management consulting firm where she led teams to design, pilot, and launch innovative solutions. As director of digital strategy at Harvard University, she piloted new digital tools/training in multiple departments to take fuller advantage of emerging technologies. McCabe founded her own venture, StoryEdge, in 2017 to foster civil/social awareness and an entrepreneurial mindset through interactive learning experiences. As director of strategic planning at the Harvard X-Media Lab, she launched the X-Media Incubator in March 2020 to help students reimagine cross-media projects as new products/new ventures. McCabe earned her B.A. in English and communications at Boston College. She earned her Ed.M. in the Technology, Innovation, and Education (TIE) Program at HGSE in 2018. She is currently researching the pandemic’s impact on education innovation and pursuing her doctoral degree in Leadership and Learning in Organizations at Vanderbilt University.
